hiddenBase: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset: a hidden-area reconstruction layer for an existing 2D game sprite. Input1 is the master nest artwork. Input2 is a supporting isolated rosette example only. Create ONE complete GREEN BASAL ROSETTE AND ATTACHED SIDE TENDRILS layer on true transparent background. Remove all white ivory petals, gold seed/chamber and green sprout from the master. Preserve the master green rosette leaf arrangement, colors, textures and attached side tendrils in exactly their original positions. Where white petals previously hid portions of the green leaves, reconstruct ONLY those missing green leaf surfaces so the fan is complete and coherent behind moving petals. The result is only rooted green leaves and their two continuous side curls, no white heart, no gold, no seed or sprout, no flowers, no shadows, no glow, no new decoration. 512x512 canvas, same front view and painting. Center root at (256,463), overall green fan bounds approximately x92..421 y315..463. Keep empty space transparent. Do not enlarge or rearrange the master leaves. This is a production animation layer, not a preview.
openingShells:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset: a production animation layer sprite sheet of SIX ivory foreground petal-shell poses. Input1 is the mature closed bud motion reference. Input2 is the exact final nest painting. Preserve their ivory cream/sage material, soft painting and dark teal outlines.
Make ONE 3-column x2-row transparent sheet, six equal square cells, left-to-right top-to-bottom. Each cell contains ONLY THE FOREGROUND IVORY PETAL WRAPS, no gold chamber/seed, no green sprout, no basal green leaves/tendrils and no back pointed roof once the wraps open. The central revealed opening MUST be a true transparent hole, because the original unchanging seed/chamber will be composited behind these shells. No text, grid, labels, background, glow or shadows.
All poses are in the same512px world-space cell: base of white foreground wraps anchored at(256,420), closed apex at(256,175), final side curl tips about(194,241) and(318,241), final front heart aboutx194..318 y342..420. Keep center, scale and attachment points fixed. After the bud is mature it DOES NOT get bigger; only the same petal material unfolds.
Cell0 fully CLOSED teardrop wrap with clean continuous ivory petal seams, completely opaque interior. Foreground white wraps cover the whole seed area. Root leaves omitted.
Cell1 tiny central slit opening, transparent narrow slit in the ivory wraps, apex and outer volume stable. No painted seed or green inside.
Cell2 quarter-open: outer wraps gently peel outward from existing seams; opening is transparent and widens gradually, small front white fold starts turning into the heart. Still one coherent attached shell.
Cell3 half-open: two ivory side curls increasingly recognizable in their correct final positions, front heart partially spread from its own basal fold. Transparent space behind and between these foreground petals.
Cell4 three-quarters-open: almost exact input2's two side white petals and front white heart, modest remaining fold inward, no size pumping. NO rear pointed roof; it is a separate static layer, so leave its area transparent.
Cell5 exact input2 FOREGROUND WHITE PETALS ONLY: left curl, right curl, front heart. Remove gold/green and back roof. Same final shapes, positions, line weight and colors as master.
Every moving petal is one solid coherent surface, with no torn patches, floating fragments, double outlines or dissolved images. Do not repaint the stationary seed/sprout/core; omit them entirely. Do not draw a complete nest in each cell. These are actual production occluder layers, not six whole-plant concepts.
productionRule: Preserve close-grow-unfurl concept. Growth finishes while closed. Master core and settled base reused at fixed coordinates. No whole-frame resizing after maturity. Late original petal-tip adjustments only; identical seed/sprout/base sample regions; exact original endpoint.
